source_policy: Use current published nondeprecated Materials Project summary records. Resolve each requested legacy alias to its returned material_id;compare fields only within the same returned identity and last_updated value. This task is conditioned on the published calculation record,not experimental bulk density. Preserve the input order in numeric answers;return the resolved canonical ID for winners.
unit_identity: 1u/angstrom^3 =1.66053906660g/cm^3. The provider field density_atomic is a packing volume in angstrom^3/atom,V/Nsites;its reciprocal is atomic number density Nsites/V. It is not a volume fraction or mass density. A mass-density ranking need not be a number-density ranking.
